evidence: Added text field 'Notes' via Fields dialog; new field appeared as column in table view, as a field in card view, in entry Add form, and in Sort dropdown options.

Created entry 'Write QA report' with text=Notes 'First QA note', number Priority=5, date Due Date=2026-09-01(Sep 1, 2026), checkbox Completed=true. Table view shows all values correctly incl. check icon; Card view shows same values incl. 'Yes' for checkbox.

issue: New entries do not persist across page reload
actual: After creating entry 'Write QA report' (visible immediately, entry count 6), reloading the page (navigate to same URL) reverted the app to the original 5 entries; the new entry was gone. localStorage is empty, confirming no persistence layer is used.

evidence: Switched from table to cards and back; same 5 entries with identical field values (name, priority, date, checkbox) in both views, order and count unchanged.

Table sorted by Priority ascending then descending via column header click - order changed correctly both times ('Sorted by Priority (descending)' shown). Cards view independently sorted by Task Name ascending. Switching back to Table retained Priority descending sort; switching to Cards retained Task Name ascending sort.

Across ascending/descending Priority sorts and Task Name sort, entry count remained 5 throughout and each entry's field values (name, priority, date, completed) were identical to pre-sort values - only row order changed.

Selecting/clicking a sort field immediately reordered visible rows; statusbar showed 'Sorted by Priority (descending)' / 'Sorted by Task Name (ascending)' identifying field+direction; app remained fully interactive afterward (view switch, other actions worked).

With no sort active, used keyboard-based drag (Space/ArrowDown/Space on drag handle) to reorder in Table view: 'Design' moved from position 1 to position 3 (Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team). Independently reordered Cards view: 'Design' moved to last position (Review, Update, Prepare, Team, Design). Switching back to Table view retained its own distinct manual order, confirming per-view independent manual ordering. Note: native Playwright drag (dragTo/browser_drag) did not trigger reorder - keyboard sensor was required.

issue: No filtering feature exists in the application
actual: Searched the entire toolbar, header, dialogs, and page DOM (via semantic snapshot, full accessibility snapshot, and text search for 'filter') - no filter control, button, or criteria UI was found anywhere. Only Search, Sort, view switch, Fields, and Add Entry controls exist. Users cannot define field-specific filter criteria.

issue: No filtering feature exists in the application
actual: No filter UI or criteria mechanism is present anywhere in the app (confirmed via DOM text search and full accessibility snapshot), so filtering behavior (inclusion of matching entries, restoring all on clear) cannot be exercised or verified - it is simply unavailable.

evidence: Typed 'REPORT' (uppercase) into search - matched 'Prepare quarterly report' case-insensitively, status showed '1 entry matching \"REPORT\"'. Clicking clear-search button restored count to '5 entries'.

issue: Search matches only raw internal values, not the formatted values shown to users
actual: Searching 'Jan 15' (the exact date text displayed in both table and card views for 'Design new landing page') returned '0 entries matching'. Searching the raw ISO value '2026-01-15' returned 1 match. Searching 'Yes' (the displayed checkbox state for 2 entries) returned '0 entries matching'. Search does not match displayed/formatted date or checkbox text.

evidence: Field-type dropdown in Configure Fields dialog clearly labeled 'Text', 'Number', 'Date', 'Checkbox'. Add Entry form provides type-appropriate controls: Task Name = <input type=text>, Priority = <input type=number> (spinbutton), Due Date = <input type=date>, Completed = checkbox button with 'Yes'/'No' label.

Priority field is a native <input type=number>. Attempting to fill 'abc' was rejected by the browser (Playwright error: 'Cannot type text into input[type=number]'); directly setting .value='abc' via JS resulted in empty string (browser discards non-numeric input). Entering valid number 42 and saving produced entry with Priority=42 correctly displayed in table.

Due Date field is a native <input type=date>. Setting invalid values ('2026-13-45', 'not-a-date') via direct value assignment resulted in the input resetting to empty string (browser rejects invalid dates). Entering valid date 2026-12-31 and saving produced entry correctly displaying 'Dec 31, 2026'.

All 7 entries display identical field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed) in both table and card views. Added a 'Notes' text field left unset on all existing entries - both table view (cell text '—') and card view (observable value '—') show the same clear empty-value representation for every entry consistently.

Entry form checkbox toggles between visible label 'No' and 'Yes' when clicked (checkbox 'Completed No' -> true state observed). Table view distinguishes states via different icons/colors: unchecked = X icon (muted gray), checked = check icon (green, class 'text-success'). Card view shows explicit 'Yes'/'No' text alongside icon for Completed field, consistent with table.

issue: No import feature exists in the application
actual: Searched entire page DOM (buttons, links, file inputs) for any 'import' control - none found. Only a static instructional note in the Configure Fields dialog mentions 'Configure fields before importing data', but there is no actual import button, file upload control, or data-import mechanism anywhere in the app to test.
